headline: Turkish Research Vessel Arrives in Pakistan for Joint Offshore Energy Exploration
summary: Turkey's seismic research vessel Oruç Reis arrived in Karachi to begin exploring offshore oil and natural gas reserves in Pakistani waters, marking an expansion in bilateral energy cooperation.
why: Pakistan relies heavily on imported hydrocarbons, making domestic offshore exploration vital for reducing its current account deficit.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Offshore seismic exploration advances potential energy security and resource discovery.
